# `silk/native_start_sync`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`.

Synchronous source startup with an owned native HostInput provider.

## When to use

Select this runtime explicitly for a hosted Darwin ARM64 or GNU Linux x86-64/ARM64 executable
whose application is an i32 Effect requiring borrowed HostInput. The default hosted runtime is
silk/native\_start, which supports broader result signatures and diagnostic observation.

## Details

Startup copies arguments and environment into owned storage, lends the provider to the
application, and releases it after the application completes. The exclusive provider loan
fulfills either a shared or exclusive HostInput requirement through ordinary service rules. Working-directory requests
observe the current directory through the ordinary provider. Applications supply every other
service themselves, including the Allocator needed by lookups that return owned bytes.

Success returns the application's status. Initialization and application typed failures drop
their owned payload and return one. This composition installs no Execution, scheduler,
diagnostic observer, or report policy. The complete application call must be NonParking.

## Gotchas

This minimal composition accepts only an i32 Effect requiring borrowed HostInput. Ordinary i32,
unit, other requirements, and parking need another source composition. Fatal traps do not
unwind and promise no cleanup.
